title: Implement local weather access and offline location settings

gates.name: Host Settings, catalog and redacted provider probes

verify: Record honest pre-implementation RED for each FT-008 AC before changing production behavior; preserve any already-green approved predecessor behavior without claiming its evidence for this task.

Run deterministic isolated Settings checks for Khujand default, valid key/location auto-save, reload persistence, invalid or missing key preservation, unknown-city preservation and the exact owning inline messages `API-ключ не указан`, `Неверный API-ключ`, `Город не найден`; reset state after the probe.

Run offline catalog checks with network unavailable: case-insensitive country search, country-first gating, selected-country city scoping, GeoNames cities15000 coverage fixture, Russian/canonical/ASCII alias matching and attribution placement before the final back-icon action.

Run a redacted city-change integration probe that observes persisted selected coordinates, the registered Settings & Location -> Weather Context refresh request and provider request shape; use only a synthetic credential and preserve valid settings when the provider or network fails.

Inspect Settings & Location ownership and the registered Main Display -> Settings & Location, Settings & Location -> Weather Context, Weather Context -> Yandex Weather Adapter and Settings & Location -> Bundled Location Catalog edges; no private-store bypass, direct provider access or composition-root business orchestration is permitted.

Use isolated/resettable local state, synthetic credentials, deterministic catalog/provider fixtures and cleanup that cannot leak a secret or affect another run. Host/build/unit/static/redacted-provider checks are mandatory. Apply target-device evidence only where host checks cannot establish Settings readability/navigation; it is deferred/non-blocking, so record DEFERRED plus residual risk when unavailable and never claim runtime PASS without a target. Record no runtime evidence during planning.

purpose: Turn the accepted Settings & Location boundary into the FT-008 weather-access outcome with local secret handling, offline country/city selection, valid location persistence and provider refresh integration.
success_outcome: A clean Android build and deterministic redacted evidence prove that a personal weather key and selected Khujand/other city are retained locally, offline country-first/scoped city search resolves the accepted aliases and attribution, a valid city change refreshes Weather Context with selected coordinates, and key/provider/city failures remain inline while preserving the last valid value and stable clock/timer behavior.
anti_goals: Do not implement FT-002 weather normalization, cache/history/freshness or weather-card presentation; consume its accepted Weather Context boundary.
Do not implement FT-001 clock/fullscreen behavior, FT-003/FT-004 forecast sessions or FT-005–FT-007 timer, overdue and alert behavior.
Do not implement FT-009 alert sound/volume, glass intensity, preview or other personalization Settings.
Do not add a shared or embedded key, backend/proxy, cloud sync, accounts, Google Services, second location source, event/message infrastructure, new dependency or unaccepted Settings control.
Do not place live credentials in source, APK resources, logs, screenshots, fixtures or verification evidence, and do not claim runtime evidence during planning.

forbidden_scope: FT-002 weather normalization/cache/history/freshness ownership and FT-009 alert/glass personalization behavior
FT-001 clock/fullscreen, FT-003/FT-004 forecast and FT-005/FT-006/FT-007 timer/overdue/alert behavior
direct reads or writes of Weather Context, Main Display or another capability's private storage

shared/embedded API keys, secret-bearing source/logs/screenshots/fixtures/evidence, backend/cloud/accounts, Google Services, event infrastructure and new dependencies
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before adding a dependency or changing the accepted UI toolkit, package/public contract, persistence/security posture, location source or product behavior.
Stop and route to /spec-design if execution requires a new module, graph edge, ownership rule, public contract or composition-root business behavior.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-008 if execution exposes a required identity, tier, dependency, acceptance or material-scope change; do not hide it behind repair.
Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-008 or /write-prd if the accepted key, offline location, alias, attribution, error-preservation or refresh semantics must change.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-009 if the implementation requires a new user-facing sound/volume/glass personalization outcome.

constraints: Settings & Location owns validation, persistence and the selected country/city/coordinates; the bundled GeoNames catalog is immutable and read-only.
The API key is accepted only from user input, travels only through the authorized Weather Context provider request path and is redacted from every durable artifact.
Valid values auto-save; invalid values remain unsaved, preserve the last valid value and expose the owning inline error. Country selection precedes and scopes city search.
Weather Context owns provider refresh, normalization, cache/history and freshness; Settings & Location requests refresh only after a valid location write.
No new provider, location source, dependency, backend, Google Services, event boundary or unaccepted Settings control is authorized.
